predecessors.name: United States of America
predecessors.text: the Palau district of the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands: 'Palau was passed formally to the United States under United Nations auspices in 1947'; the Republic of Palau since 1 January 1981

ledger.x: 1994: Palau becomes independent in free association with the United States.
2006: the capital moves from Koror to Ngerulmud in Melekeok state.

certainty.note: Island coasts; maritime limits are not drawn.

sources.title: Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands
